mapper.sql: SELECT r.id, r.task_id, tk.task_no, r.tree_id, t.tree_code, t.species, t.location, r.worker_id, w.real_name AS worker_name, r.client_id, c.client_name, r.trim_type, r.actual_trim_time, r.cut_branch_count, r.keep_branch_count, r.work_content, r.ai_suggestion, r.score, r.comment, r.evaluate_time, r.status, r.create_time FROM trim_record r LEFT JOIN trim_task tk ON r.task_id = tk.id LEFT JOIN tree t ON r.tree_id = t.id LEFT JOIN sys_user w ON r.worker_id = w.id LEFT JOIN sys_client c ON r.client_id = c.id
mapper.select:
r.client_id = #{clientId} AND r.actual_trim_time >= CAST(#{startDate} AS DATE) AND r.actual_trim_time < DATEADD(DAY, 1, CAST(#{endDate} AS DATE))
ORDER BY r.actual_trim_time DESC, r.id DESC

SELECT id, task_id, tree_id, worker_id, client_id, trim_type, actual_trim_time, cut_branch_count, keep_branch_count, work_content, ai_suggestion, score, comment, evaluate_time, status, create_time, update_time FROM trim_record WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO trim_record (task_id, tree_id, worker_id, client_id, trim_type, actual_trim_time, cut_branch_count, keep_branch_count, work_content, ai_suggestion, status, create_time) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{treeId}, #{workerId}, #{clientId}, #{trimType}, #{actualTrimTime}, #{cutBranchCount}, #{keepBranchCount}, #{workContent}, #{aiSuggestion}, #{status}, SYSDATETIME())
mapper.update: UPDATE trim_record SET score = #{score}, comment = #{comment}, evaluate_time = #{evaluateTime}, status = #{status}, update_time = SYSDATETIME() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id AS record_id, actual_trim_time, trim_type, score, comment, work_content FROM trim_record WHERE tree_id = #{treeId} ORDER BY actual_trim_time ASC, id ASC
SELECT CAST(actual_trim_time AS DATE) AS [date], score FROM trim_record WHERE tree_id = #{treeId} AND score IS NOT NULL ORDER BY actual_trim_time ASC

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT tree_id) FROM trim_record
AND actual_trim_time >= CAST(#{startDate} AS DATE) AND actual_trim_time < DATEADD(DAY, 1, CAST(#{endDate} AS DATE))
SELECT AVG(CAST(score AS DECIMAL(5, 2))) FROM trim_record WHERE score IS NOT NULL AND actual_trim_time >= CAST(#{startDate} AS DATE) AND actual_trim_time < DATEADD(DAY, 1, CAST(#{endDate} AS DATE))

SELECT CONVERT(varchar(10), actual_trim_time, 23) AS [date], COUNT(1) AS [count] FROM trim_record
AND actual_trim_time >= CAST(#{startDate} AS DATE) AND actual_trim_time < DATEADD(DAY, 1, CAST(#{endDate} AS DATE))
GROUP BY CONVERT(varchar(10), actual_trim_time, 23) ORDER BY [date] ASC

SELECT u.id AS worker_id, u.real_name AS worker_name, COUNT(DISTINCT tk.id) AS task_count, COUNT(DISTINCT r.id) AS trim_count, AVG(CAST(r.score AS DECIMAL(5, 2))) AS avg_score FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN trim_task tk ON tk.worker_id = u.id AND tk.create_time >= CAST(#{startDate} AS DATE) AND tk.create_time < DATEADD(DAY, 1, CAST(#{endDate} AS DATE)) LEFT JOIN trim_record r ON r.worker_id = u.id AND r.actual_trim_time >= CAST(#{startDate} AS DATE) AND r.actual_trim_time < DATEADD(DAY, 1, CAST(#{endDate} AS DATE)) WHERE u.role = 'WORKER' GROUP BY u.id, u.real_name ORDER BY task_count DESC, trim_count DESC

SELECT CONVERT(varchar(7), evaluate_time, 120) AS [date], AVG(CAST(score AS DECIMAL(5, 2))) AS score, COUNT(1) AS [count] FROM trim_record WHERE client_id = #{clientId} AND score IS NOT NULL AND evaluate_time IS NOT NULL AND evaluate_time >= DATEADD(MONTH, -#{months}, SYSDATETIME()) GROUP BY CONVERT(varchar(7), evaluate_time, 120) ORDER BY [date] ASC
